scenes.time: light green at the edges and gold in the middle, moving slowly across the sand
scenes.key_moment: He wakes on the sand at the bottom of the golden kelp forest, breathing water, with a girl and a seal-like hound above him (c01.s01.p001.1, c01.s01.p003.2-p003.5, c01.s01.p005.1-p006.1)

backgrounds: Kelp Forest, seabed, golden brass-coloured stems, green-gold light
sprites: Wrack (surface boots, torn grey jacket with half-ripped corporate crest, red cable-tie marks on wrists)
Sefa (about sixteen, thin, long limbed, dark hair tied back with a shining strip, large nearly black eyes, harvesting hook)

scenes.key_moment: The Maker dome the size of a hill at the top of the terraces, half lit and half dark with glowing weed hung on the dark panes (c01.s02.p005.1, c01.s02.p006.1-p006.9)

backgrounds: Low Anthem Terraces, walled terraces of kelp rows
Sea-door pool inside the dome, stone floor, lamplight
sprites: Hold people (long-limbed, dark-eyed, grey-green sea-silk tunics)
expressions: Wrack: hurt by first breath of air

scenes.time: Three days; Oro's visit on the second evening
scenes.key_moment: Ione lifts the water from the bowl in her two hands, holding its shape, and lays it on Wrack's head (c01.s03.p012.4-p012.5, c01.s03.p017.1-p017.3)

backgrounds: Low Anthem Dry Room, stone, lamplit
sprites: Elder Oro (very old, carved stick, bald brown head)
Ione (broad, calm, sleeves rolled, scarred forearms)

scenes.time: Days of work and evenings; the ninth day for the lamp, hour not stated
scenes.key_moment: The Maker lamp comes on and white light pours down the hall while Elder Oro sits on the floor and weeps (c01.s04.p021.2-p021.8, c01.s04.p022.1, c01.s04.p023.1-p023.4, c01.s04.p024.1-p024.3)

backgrounds: Low Anthem Meeting Hall, round and high, with the Maker lamp column at its centre
Long dry hall at night, hammocks
